source: Hey, are you okay? I know that was hard, but look at the payoff. It's not exactly what we were hoping for, but we still managed to alter a living organism. Not a human being yet, but we're so close now! Ah, the report's in. Let's see... We did it! The experiment was a success. It seems this particular alteration was caused by an additional influence of the Radius. Our scientists will try to reproduce it in labs outside. And that's not all, you and I have been chosen for the next crucial step. We did great!

source:
UNPSC Explorers Facilities are fortified standalone multifunctional complexes for housing UNPSC Explorers, equipped with everything they need for their life and work.
Explorer Facilities were usually set up in old buildings at the edge of the Pechorsk Anomaly, near the exit points used by Altered Humans assigned as Explorers.
In 2003, the Standard UNPSC Explorer Facility Project was established. Since then, all Explorer Facilities have been built based on the standard modular structure. Some of the existing Facilities were also rebuilt in accordance with the project.
All Facilities are equipped with the following standard units:
• Security checkpoint with gates
• Command Room
• Training Ground
• <L1>Dormitory</L1>
• <L1>Supply Depot</L1>
• <L1>Shooting Range</L1>
• <L2>Armory</L2>
• <L10>Laboratory</L10>
reference_ru: UNPSC Услуги предоставляются В отделе обслуживания клиентов, но только при условии, что они связаны с тяжелой работой и ожирением. Что касается самого простого подхода, то любая тренировка любого из наших медведей может быть направлена только на достижение поставленных целей, поэтому, пожалуйста, следуйте инструкциям. Я клянусь богом, что эта заноза в заднице не прошла бы без родителей. Я посторонний, я не виновен, я несу ответственность за работника.
